files.description: The sole EHI export documentation artifact. 9-page PDF (created 2025-03-01) describing the §170.315(b)(10) export mechanism. Contains: overview of the export ZIP structure (CDA XML + CSV + documents), step-by-step export instructions for single patient and bulk/population export, and a detailed CDA data dictionary mapping clinical data elements to XPATH paths and code systems (SNOMED, ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm, CVX, CPT, NDC, HCPCS, GMDN). Covers CCD sections for demographics, encounters, immunizations, treatment plan, social history, problems, medications, allergies, labs, vitals, goals, procedures, care team, referrals, implantable devices, mental status, functional status, and health concerns. CSV exports for demographics/insurance and appointments are mentioned but not field-documented. A final sentence references FHIR Bulk Data export as an alternative pathway.

Screenshot of the EHI export landing page showing the page title 'EHI Export b.10 Documentation' and a single download link to the PDF. The page contains no other substantive content — just the ethizo navigation header and the download link.
